points.title: 童年质赵
points.description: 秦始皇出生于赵国邯郸，作为秦国王子异人的质子。这段经历使他早期生活在敌对国家，经历了颠沛流离的童年。在赵国期间，他学会了坚韧和适应能力，同时也目睹了战国时期的混乱局面。这段经历可能影响了他后来统一六国的决心和对稳定秩序的渴望。公元前251年，秦昭襄王去世，异人得以回国继承王位，秦始皇也随父返回秦国。
points.descriptionEn: Qin Shi Huang was born in Handan, the capital of the state of Zhao, as a hostage prince of the state of Qin. During this period, he experienced a turbulent childhood in an enemy state, which likely shaped his character and determination. Living in Zhao exposed him to the chaos of the Warring States period, possibly influencing his later desire to unify China. In 251 BCE, after King Zhaoxiang of Qin died, his father Ying Zheng (later King Zhuangxiang) returned to Qin to ascend the throne, and the young prince accompanied him back to his homeland.

points.title: 继位亲政
points.description: 公元前247年，13岁的嬴政即位成为秦王。初期由吕不韦和太后赵姬辅政，但实际权力掌握在相邦吕不韦手中。公元前238年，嬴政在雍城举行冠礼，正式亲政。他迅速铲除了嫪毐叛乱，随后罢黜吕不韦，开始掌握实权。在咸阳期间，他重用李斯、尉缭等人才，推行富国强兵政策，为统一六国奠定基础。这一阶段，他展现了卓越的政治手腕和决断力。
points.descriptionEn: In 247 BCE, at the age of 13, Ying Zheng ascended the throne as King of Qin. Initially, power was held by his regent, Lü Buwei, and his mother, the Queen Dowager Zhao. In 238 BCE, after performing the capping ceremony in Yongcheng, the young king formally assumed power. He quickly suppressed the rebellion of Lao Ai and subsequently dismissed Lü Buwei, consolidating his authority. During this period in Xianyang, he appointed talented officials like Li Si and Wei Liao, implementing policies to strengthen the state and prepare for the unification of China.

points.title: 统一六国
points.description: 从公元前230年开始，秦始皇发动了一系列军事行动，先后灭韩、赵、魏、楚、燕、齐六国，结束了长达500多年的战国分裂局面。他采用远交近攻、合纵连横的策略，重用王翦等军事将领，建立了强大的中央集权国家。统一过程中，他推行法家思想，加强军事实力，实施严苛的军法。公元前221年，完成统一，自称'始皇帝'，建立中国历史上第一个统一的中央集权封建王朝。这一成就奠定了中国两千多年封建社会的基本格局。
points.descriptionEn: Starting in 230 BCE, Qin Shi Huang launched a series of military campaigns, successively conquering the states of Han, Zhao, Wei, Chu, Yan, and Qi, ending over 500 years of division during the Warring States period. He employed strategies of befriending distant states while attacking nearby ones, and appointed skilled military generals like Wang Jian. During this period, he promoted Legalist philosophy, strengthened military power, and implemented strict military laws. In 221 BCE, upon completing the unification, he proclaimed himself 'First Emperor' (Shi Huangdi), establishing China's first unified centralized feudal dynasty, which laid the foundation for Chinese society for the next two millennia.

points.title: 统一改革
points.description: 统一六国后，秦始皇在咸阳推行了一系列重大改革：废除分封制，实行郡县制；统一文字、货币、度量衡；修建驰道、直道等交通网络；北击匈奴，修筑长城；南征百越，开凿灵渠。他还焚书坑儒，加强思想控制。这一系列措施极大地促进了经济文化交流，巩固了中央集权，但也激化了社会矛盾。秦始皇多次巡游全国，东至琅琊、碣石，南至会稽，北至九原，宣扬皇威，同时也考察民情，镇压反抗。这一时期，他的统治达到了顶峰，但也埋下了秦朝迅速灭亡的种子。
points.descriptionEn: After unifying China, Qin Shi Huang implemented a series of major reforms in Xianyang: abolishing the enfeoffment system in favor of commanderies and counties; standardizing writing, currency, and measurements; constructing transportation networks like the Chi roads and Zhi roads; attacking the Xiongnu in the north and building the Great Wall; conquering Baiyue in the south and constructing the Ling Canal. He also ordered the burning of books and burying of scholars to strengthen ideological control. These measures greatly promoted economic and cultural exchange and consolidated central authority but also intensified social contradictions. The emperor made several inspection tours throughout the empire, from Langya and Jieshi in the east to Kuaiji in the south and Jiuyuan in the north, to display imperial power while also inspecting local conditions and suppressing resistance.

points.title: 巡游驾崩
points.description: 公元前210年，秦始皇第五次巡游天下，途中病重。在沙丘平台(今河北广宗)病逝，享年50岁。临终前，他留下遗诏让长子扶苏继位，但中车府令赵高与丞相李斯、宦官胡亥合谋，篡改遗诏，赐死扶苏，立胡亥为帝，即秦二世。这一事件直接导致了秦朝的迅速灭亡。秦始皇死后葬于骊山陵(今西安临潼)，规模宏大，兵马俑陪葬坑的发现震惊世界。他的死亡标志着一个时代的结束，也预示着秦朝的短暂统治。
points.descriptionEn: In 210 BCE, during his fifth imperial tour, Qin Shi Huang fell seriously ill while traveling. He died at the Shaqiu Platform (present-day Guangzong, Hebei) at the age of 50. On his deathbed, he left an edict naming his eldest son Fusu as the successor. However, the chief eunuch Zhao Gao, Chancellor Li Si, and the emperor's youngest son Hu Hai conspired to alter the edict, forcing Fusu to commit suicide and installing Hu Hai as the new emperor (Er Shi Huang). This event directly led to the rapid collapse of the Qin Dynasty. After his death, the emperor was buried in his mausoleum at Lishan (present-day Lintong, Xi'an), the scale of which, including the famous Terracotta Army, has amazed the world. His death marked the end of an era and foreshadowed the brief rule of the Qin Dynasty.

supporter.zh: 秦始皇被视为中国历史上伟大的统一者和改革者。他结束了战国时期的分裂局面，建立了中国历史上第一个中央集权的统一国家，奠定了中国两千多年封建社会的基本格局。他推行的统一文字、货币、度量衡等措施，极大地促进了中华民族的融合与交流。修筑长城、驰道等基础设施，加强了国防和交通，为后世发展奠定了基础。秦始皇的雄才大略和远见卓识，使他成为中国历史上最具影响力的统治者之一。
supporter.en: Qin Shi Huang is regarded as a great unifier and reformer in Chinese history. He ended the division of the Warring States period and established China's first centralized unified state, laying the foundation for Chinese feudal society for over two millennia. His policies of standardizing writing, currency, and measurements greatly promoted the integration and exchange of the Chinese people. Infrastructure projects like the Great Wall and imperial roads strengthened national defense and transportation, laying the groundwork for future development. His vision and decisive leadership make him one of the most influential rulers in Chinese history.

critic.zh: 秦始皇的统治也充满争议和批评。他实行严刑峻法，焚书坑儒，压制思想自由，导致文化断层。大兴土木，修建阿房宫、骊山陵等工程，耗费巨大民力财力，导致民不聊生。连年征战，加重百姓负担。他的专制统治缺乏制衡机制，导致权力滥用。秦朝二世而亡，也反映出其统治政策的失败。秦始皇的暴政成为后世专制统治的负面典型，被儒家学者长期批判。
critic.en: Qin Shi Huang's rule was also marked by controversy and criticism. He implemented harsh laws, ordered the burning of books and burying of scholars, suppressing intellectual freedom and causing a cultural rupture. His massive construction projects, such as the Epang Palace and his mausoleum, consumed enormous resources and labor, leading to widespread suffering. Continuous warfare further burdened the common people. His autocratic rule lacked checks and balances, leading to abuse of power. The rapid fall of the Qin Dynasty after his death reflects the failure of his policies. His tyrannical rule became a negative archetype for later autocratic governance and was long criticized by Confucian scholars.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，秦始皇是一位具有划时代意义的统治者。他开创的中央集权制度影响了中国两千多年的政治体制。他的统一措施促进了中华民族的形成和巩固。在考古学上，兵马俑等发现展现了秦代高超的工艺水平。在流行文化中，秦始皇的形象复杂多元，既有雄才大略的帝王形象，也有残暴专制的暴君形象。现代学术界对秦始皇的评价更加客观全面，既肯定其历史功绩，也指出其统治的局限性和负面影响。秦始皇的一生反映了中国早期国家形成过程中的复杂性和矛盾性。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Qin Shi Huang was a ruler of epoch-making significance. The centralized system he established influenced Chinese political structure for over two millennia. His unification measures promoted the formation and consolidation of the Chinese nation. Archaeologically, discoveries like the Terracotta Army showcase the advanced craftsmanship of the Qin Dynasty. In popular culture, Qin Shi Huang's image is complex and multifaceted, embodying both the visionary emperor and the tyrannical despot. Modern scholarship offers more balanced assessments, acknowledging his historical contributions while recognizing the limitations and negative aspects of his rule. His life reflects the complexity and contradictions in the early formation of the Chinese state.

self.zh: 朕为始皇帝。后世以计数，二世三世至于万世，传之无穷。
self.en: I am the First Emperor. Let my descendants be known as the Second, Third, and so on, to the tenth thousandth generation, and may the imperial succession be perpetual.

others.zh: 始皇奋六世之余烈，振长策而御宇内，吞二周而亡诸侯，履至尊而制六合，执敲扑而鞭笞天下，威振四海。
others.en: The First Emperor, building on the achievements of six generations of predecessors, wielded his whip to control the universe, swallowed the two Zhou states and conquered the feudal lords, treaded upon the highest position and ruled the six directions, and used his power to whip the entire world, his might shaking the four seas.
